title: S1 draft A: finite world, truth model, reset/restart/observer and the C3 registered reset model
objective: Write contract section A: the exact finite world, its truth model enumerated separately from the ruler, reset and restart as separate predicates, the observer model, and the C3 registered finite model with known escapes placed inside or outside it.
problem: NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s3 needs, before S2: the claim (a useful retained bit across a named boundary with an explicitly allowed channel); finite organism state plus a modelled pending-message channel and every schedule/counter/observer state that affects future output; world-side outputs enumerated separately from the ruler, with all legal histories, exogenous inputs, delays, repeated resets and the horizon (a modelled delay longer than the test horizon blocks closure); reset = erase forbidden past while preserving declared allowed state; restart equivalence as a separate predicate. Closure C3: state the delay horizon in episodes and the number of repeated resets the model covers, and list which known escapes of BOTH harnesses fall inside the model (must now be caught) and which fall outside (stay listed); place at least Fable's G6.reset escapes (a carry hidden from the reported state and used two episodes later; a reset that leaks on every third call). For each of T01-T08 and E06 give the case and its independently stated expected fact (plan s4, with C1's T02 wording: calibration gate PASS; retention ruler NEGATIVE, exact 1/2). Each clause needs an attainable true and false case, or a stated coupling (plan s4). Name the concrete implementation files and finite state bounds (plan s3 last paragraph).
